source_text: [Design Is a Job by Mike Monteiro (2012-05-04).md] The integration of digital culture and technology into graphic design practice fundamentally transforms design processes, tools, and the relationship between designers and their audiences. source_text: [Design is storytelling (Lupton, Ellen, author) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).md] Color functions as both a cultural identifier and emotional trigger, carrying meaning beyond its physical properties. name: Expert Overconfidence and Cognitive Laziness
source_text: [The Art of Doing Science and Engineering Learning to Learn (Richard W. Hamming).md] A principle describing how experts become overconfident in their approaches and fail to consider the basis for their beliefs when applied to new situations.

name: Innovation Cycles in Art and Technology
source_text: [Graphic Design Theory Readings from the Field by Helen Armstrong.md] A principle describing how artistic innovations follow cycles of invention, variation, and eventual obsolescence, with each new invention requiring a period of development and refinement before becoming mechanical and losing its impact.

name: Directional Changes (dc) in Financial Data
source_text: [AI for Finance (AI for Everything) -- Edward P_ K_ Tsang -- AI for Everything, 1, 2023 -- Taylor & Francis Group -- isbn13 9781000878523] A method for detecting regime changes in financial time series data by identifying significant directional movements in price or return data, originally developed by Richard Olsen.

name: Generous Audacious Marketing
source_text: [This Is Marketing You Can_t Be Seen Until You Learn to See.md] Great marketing is characterized by the bold assertion that a better alternative exists and a willingness to lead users toward it, rather than simply offering a marginal improvement or alternative. This approach requires a generous vision that sees potential in a better future and the audacity to communicate that vision to users.

name: Recovered Memory Therapy and False Accusations
source_text: [Mistakes Were Made (But Not by Me) (Carol Tavris) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).md] A controversial therapeutic approach where patients allegedly recover memories of abuse through therapy, which can lead to false accusations and severe emotional trauma for all parties involved.

name: Procedural Vs Declarative Knowledge Retrieval
source_text: [Godel, Escher, Bach-An Eternal Golden Braid (Douglas R. Hofstadter).md] A principle describing how different types of questions can trigger either declarative knowledge retrieval or procedural problem-solving methods, demonstrating metaknowledge about one's own knowledge classification.

name: Same-age Peer Modeling
source_text: [Influence - The Psychology of Persuasion (Collins Business Essentials) by Robert B. Cialdini (z-lib.org).md] Individuals are more effectively influenced by models who share their age group, particularly when the model's experience directly mirrors their own life stage. This principle describes a psychological mechanism where age-matched peer examples increase the perceived relevance and applicability of a behavior or attitude change.
